245     def _fix_broken_tool_use(self, messages: list[Message]) -> list[Message]:
246         """Fix broken tool use/result pairs in message history.
247 
248         This method handles two issues:
249         1. Orphaned toolUse messages without corresponding toolResult.
250            Before 1.15.0, strands had a bug where they persisted sessions with a potentially broken messages array.
251            This method retroactively fixes that issue by adding a tool_result outside of session management.
252            After 1.15.0, this bug is no longer present.
253         2. Orphaned toolResult messages without corresponding toolUse (e.g., when pagination truncates messages)
254 
255         Args:
256             messages: The list of messages to fix
257             agent_id: The agent ID for fetching previous messages
258             removed_message_count: Number of messages removed by the conversation manager
259 
260         Returns:
261             Fixed list of messages with proper tool use/result pairs
262         """
263         # First, check if the oldest message has orphaned toolResult (no preceding toolUse) and remove it.
264         if messages:
265             first_message = messages[0]
266             if first_message["role"] == "user" and any("toolResult" in content for content in first_message["content"]):
267                 logger.warning(
268                     "Session message history starts with orphaned toolResult with no preceding toolUse. "
269                     "This typically happens when messages are truncated due to pagination limits. "
270                     "Removing orphaned toolResult message to maintain valid conversation structure."
271                 )
272                 messages.pop(0)
273 
274         # Then check for orphaned toolUse messages. Snapshot the eligible indices before
275         # iterating so that inserting a toolResult (which shifts later indices) does not
276         # cause the loop to skip a subsequent orphaned toolUse. The trailing message is
277         # excluded from the snapshot because that case is handled in the agent class when
278         # a new prompt arrives, so we do not synthesize a toolResult into persisted
279         # history for it here. Walking in reverse means each insert only shifts already-
280         # processed positions, so the original snapshot indices remain valid.
281         original_last_index = len(messages) - 1
282         tool_use_indices = [
283             index
284             for index, message in enumerate(messages)
285             if index < original_last_index and any("toolUse" in content for content in message["content"])
286         ]
287         for index in reversed(tool_use_indices):
288             message = messages[index]
289             tool_use_ids = [
290                 content["toolUse"]["toolUseId"] for content in message["content"] if "toolUse" in content
291             ]
292 
293             # Check the toolResult ids already present in the next message.
294             tool_result_ids = [
295                 content["toolResult"]["toolUseId"]
296                 for content in messages[index + 1]["content"]
297                 if "toolResult" in content
298             ]
299 
300             missing_tool_use_ids = list(set(tool_use_ids) - set(tool_result_ids))
301             if not missing_tool_use_ids:
302                 continue
303 
304             logger.warning(
305                 "Session message history has an orphaned toolUse with no toolResult. "
306                 "Adding toolResult content blocks to create valid conversation."
307             )
308             missing_content_blocks = generate_missing_tool_result_content(missing_tool_use_ids)
309 
310             if tool_result_ids:
311                 # If there were any toolResult ids, that means only some of the content blocks are missing
312                 messages[index + 1]["content"].extend(missing_content_blocks)
313             else:
314                 # The message following the toolUse was not a toolResult, so lets insert it
315                 messages.insert(index + 1, {"role": "user", "content": missing_content_blocks})
316         return messages

35         **kwargs: Any,

42         Args:

46             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
47 
48         """

53         if session is None:
54             logger.debug("session_id=<%s> | session not found, creating new session", self.session_id)
55             self._is_new_session = True

57             session_repository.create_session(session)
58         else:
59             self._is_new_session = False
60 
61         self.session = session
62 
63         # Keep track of the latest message of each agent in case we need to redact it.
64         self._latest_agent_message: dict[str, SessionMessage | None] = {}
65 
66         # Track the previously synced internal state for each agent to detect changes.

102     def sync_agent(self, agent: "Agent", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
103         """Serialize and update the agent into the session repository.
104 
105         Only updates the agent if state has been modified or internal state has changed.
106         This optimization reduces unnecessary I/O operations when the agent processes
107         messages without modifying its state.
108 
109         Args:
110             agent: Agent to sync to the session.
111             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
112         """
113         # Get current versions and conversation manager state
114         current_state_version = agent.state._get_version()
115         current_interrupt_state_version = agent._interrupt_state._get_version()
116         current_conversation_manager_state = agent.conversation_manager.get_state()
117         current_model_state = agent._model_state
118 
119         # Check if we have a previous state to compare against
120         last_synced = self._last_synced_internal_state.get(agent.agent_id)
121 
122         # Determine if we need to update by comparing versions
123         if last_synced is None:
124             # First sync for this agent - always update
125             state_changed = True
126             internal_state_changed = True
127             conversation_manager_state_changed = True
128         else:
129             state_changed = current_state_version != last_synced.get("state_version")
130             internal_state_changed = current_interrupt_state_version != last_synced.get(
131                 "interrupt_state_version"
132             ) or current_model_state != last_synced.get("model_state")
133             conversation_manager_state_changed = current_conversation_manager_state != last_synced.get(
134                 "conversation_manager_state"
135             )
136 
137         if not state_changed and not internal_state_changed and not conversation_manager_state_changed:
138             logger.debug(
139                 "agent_id=<%s> | session_id=<%s> | skipping sync, no changes detected",
140                 agent.agent_id,
141                 self.session_id,
142             )
143             return
144 
145         logger.debug(
146             "agent_id=<%s> | session_id=<%s> | state_changed=<%s>, internal_state_changed=<%s>, "
147             "conversation_manager_state_changed=<%s> | syncing agent",
148             agent.agent_id,
149             self.session_id,
150             state_changed,
151             internal_state_changed,
152             conversation_manager_state_changed,
153         )
154 
155         # Perform the update
156         self.session_repository.update_agent(
157             self.session_id,
158             SessionAgent.from_agent(agent),
159         )
160 
161         # Update tracked versions after successful sync
162         self._last_synced_internal_state[agent.agent_id] = {
163             "state_version": current_state_version,
164             "interrupt_state_version": current_interrupt_state_version,
165             "conversation_manager_state": copy.deepcopy(current_conversation_manager_state),
166             "model_state": copy.deepcopy(current_model_state),
167         }

169     def initialize(self, agent: "Agent", **kwargs: Any) -> None:
170         """Initialize an agent with a session.
171 
172         Args:
173             agent: Agent to initialize from the session
174             **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for future extensibility.
175         """
176         if agent.agent_id in self._latest_agent_message:
177             raise SessionException("The `agent_id` of an agent must be unique in a session.")
178         self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = None
179 
180         # Skip read_agent call for new sessions since no agents can exist yet
181         if self._is_new_session:
182             session_agent = None
183         else:
184             session_agent = self.session_repository.read_agent(self.session_id, agent.agent_id)
185 
186         if session_agent is None:
187             logger.debug(
188                 "agent_id=<%s> | session_id=<%s> | creating agent",
189                 agent.agent_id,
190                 self.session_id,
191             )
192 
193             session_agent = SessionAgent.from_agent(agent)
194             self.session_repository.create_agent(self.session_id, session_agent)
195             # Initialize messages with sequential indices
196             session_message = None
197             for i, message in enumerate(agent.messages):
198                 session_message = SessionMessage.from_message(message, i)
199                 self.session_repository.create_message(self.session_id, agent.agent_id, session_message)
200             self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = session_message
201         else:
202             logger.debug(
203                 "agent_id=<%s> | session_id=<%s> | restoring agent",
204                 agent.agent_id,
205                 self.session_id,
206             )
207             agent.state = AgentState(session_agent.state)
208 
209             session_agent.initialize_internal_state(agent)
210 
211             # Restore the conversation manager to its previous state, and get the optional prepend messages
212             prepend_messages = agent.conversation_manager.restore_from_session(session_agent.conversation_manager_state)
213 
214             if prepend_messages is None:
215                 prepend_messages = []
216 
217             # List the messages currently in the session, using an offset of the messages previously removed
218             # by the conversation manager.
219             session_messages = self.session_repository.list_messages(
220                 session_id=self.session_id,
221                 agent_id=agent.agent_id,
222                 offset=agent.conversation_manager.removed_message_count,
223             )
224             if len(session_messages) > 0:
225                 self._latest_agent_message[agent.agent_id] = session_messages[-1]
226 
227             # Skip restoring messages when conversation is managed server-side
228             if agent.model.stateful:
229                 logger.debug(
230                     "agent_id=<%s> | session_id=<%s> | skipping message restore for server-managed conversation",
231                     agent.agent_id,
232                     self.session_id,
233                 )
234             else:
235                 # Restore the agents messages array including the optional prepend messages
236                 agent.messages = prepend_messages + [
237                     session_message.to_message() for session_message in session_messages
238                 ]
239 
240                 # Fix broken session histories: https://github.com/strands-agents/harness-sdk/issues/859
241                 agent.messages = self._fix_broken_tool_use(agent.messages)
242 
243         self._is_new_session = False
